method.dW: dW = effective_scaling * B @ A, computed from saved tensors in float64 on CPU
method.factorization: B=Qb@Rb; A.T=Qa@Ra_t; core=Rb@Ra_t.T; core=U@diag(S)@Vh; left=Qb@U; right=Qa@Vh.T; dW=scaling*left@diag(S)@right.T
method.singular_values: compact singular values are S*abs(scaling), sorted by the core SVD
method.rank_formula: tol = max(dW_rows,dW_columns) * eps_float64 * max_singular_value; rank = count(compact_singular_values > tol), equivalent to numpy.linalg.matrix_rank's standard tolerance
method.zero_definitions: compact exact zeros use sigma == 0.0; near zeros use sigma < 1e-12 and include exact zeros. full exact zeros = max(min(dW_shape)-r,0) factorization-implied zeros + compact exact zeros.
method.principal_angles: cosines = svdvals(basis_before.T @ basis_after), clipped to [0,1]; left/right singular subspaces and Qb/Qa factor bases are reported separately

required: same A/B/dW shapes and effective scaling
both factorizations reconstruct their real dW within factor_rtol
left and right full compact singular-subspace min cosine >= 1-direction_tolerance
before singular directions plus after core singular values reconstruct real after dW within replacement_rtol
same_source_criterion.note: Individual singular-vector cosines are diagnostic only because signs and degenerate subspaces are non-unique.

method.source_policy: Directory names never establish provenance. The surgery_report source field and numerical evidence are reported separately.

summary.support_meaning: Numerical consistency plus no contradictory source field; static weights cannot independently prove file provenance.
